Test Name: Search Events - Valid Search Criteria
Steps:
1. Select "Events" from Object Type dropdown
2. Enter valid search criteria
3. Click Search button or press Enter

Expected Result: System navigates to Event details page. Displays complete information (name date time location description attendees etc)

Test Name: Search with Empty Criteria
Steps:
1. Select any Object Type from dropdown
2. Leave search criteria field empty
3. Click Search button or press Enter
Expected Result: System displays error message indicating search criteria is required. No results displayed. User remains on Search page

Test Name: Search with No Matching Results
Steps:
1. Select any Object Type from dropdown
2. Enter search criteria that matches no objects (e.g. "NonExistentObject123")
3. Click Search button or press Enter
Expected Result: System displays message indicating no results found. Results list is empty or shows ""No results found"" message. User remains on Search page

Test Name: Search with Invalid Object Type Selection
Steps:
1. Do not select any Object Type (leave dropdown at default/empty state)
2. Enter valid search criteria
3. Click Search button or press Enter
Expected Result: System displays error message indicating Object Type must be selected. No search performed. User remains on Search page

Test Name: Search with Special Characters
Steps:
1. Select any Object Type from dropdown
2. Enter search criteria with special characters (e.g. "Test@#$%^&*()")
3. Click Search button or press Enter
Expected Result: System handles special characters appropriately. Either displays matching results or ""No results found"" message. System does not crash or display error

Test Name: Search with Very Long String
Steps:
1. Select any Object Type from dropdown
2. Enter a very long search string (e.g. 1000+ characters)
3. Click Search button or press Enter
Expected Result: System handles long strings appropriately. Search executes without error. Results displayed or ""No results found"" message shown

Test Name: Rapid Object Type Switching
Steps:
1. Select "Events" from Object Type dropdown
2. Quickly switch to "Users"
3. Quickly switch to "Accounts"
4. Enter search criteria
5. Click Search button
Expected Result: System correctly uses the last selected Object Type. Search executes for correct object type. Results match selected object type

Test Name: Search Results Display Format
Precondition: User has performed a search with results
Steps:
1. Perform any successful search
2. Observe the search results display
Expected Result: Results displayed in clear readable format. Each result item is clickable. Results show relevant information for selected object type. Results properly paginated if many results. Loading indicator shown during search execution

Test Name: Navigation Back from Details Page
Precondition: User is on object details page (navigated from search results)
Steps: 1. Click browser back button or application back button
Expected Result: System navigates back to search results page. Search results still displayed. Search criteria and object type selection preserved
